method.name: query-tblastn-fast
method.role: Translate all six query frames only; use fast protein-to-nucleotide search against unchanged core_nt
limits: Separate algorithm, not asserted equivalent to tblastx
Pool frames and cap250subjects and5HSPs per original read/subject after search
Raw per-frame outputs retained; pool caps sorted deterministically by bitscore, alignment length and subject ID
Coverage threshold is expressed on each peptide frame
Invalid-composition frame warnings retained; original reads never removed from denominator

input_manifest.selection_rule: SHA256 same-reference-v1:flag:seq_id; disjoint strata baseline,AA12_added,NT20_added in that order; unique samples within each stratum; no BLAST or NR outcome used
limits: Selected diagnostic panel, not population accuracy or prevalence
Identical separate available mate sequences; production validation merges/joins mates
Baseline and additions deliberately enriched; strata overlap in parent panel but each pair included once here

command: 6 qseqid sseqid staxids bitscore evalue length pident qcovs qcovhsp qlen slen qstart qend sstart send qframe sframe qseq sseq
normalization: Map every frame to original nucleotide coordinates; pool per original read; retain250best subjects and5best HSPs per subject; aggregate nucleotide qcovs over retained HSPs. Raw frame outputs and warnings retained. No verdict extrapolated between reads.
